claims.summary: Under all used-node-jet-erasure and fixed zero-respecting prefix-compiler hypotheses, let original normalized binary flat-CNF sequent refutation pi have size S>=2 and depth d, use transformation pihat at t>=1,R=S+t+1, and r original clause/Boolean/commutator placeholder labels. Let c_pi,c_pihat be commutative coefficient vectors of the homogeneous placeholder-linear compiled certificates. Arithmetic circuits are over F2 with unbounded-fan-in sum/product gates and gate/wire size. If size-U depth-u polynomial circuit H satisfies H(a,c_pi(a))=H(a,c_pihat(a)) at every Boolean old point, the original Boolean probe value has such circuit size O(U+(r+1)R^48) and depth<=u+16. At fixed u and U,r,R polynomial in Boolean input length this gives AC0[2]; polynomial size in formula encoding length N alone is not silently identified with that condition. Extract the prefix tuple by A_t(x,e_j)-A_t(x,0), then compose H. Only two-image pointwise invariance is required, not full-coset or formal invariance. Transformation costs proof size O(R^4), proof depth max(d,4), compiled size O(R^48) and depth max(d,4)+10; a restricted resource class need not contain both images. No bounded-fan-in depth conversion, formal or complete-jet extraction, hard invariant or Frege bound is obtained.

No independent novelty or lower-bound advance claimed.
